# Code of conduct

Treat contributors respectfully. Do not harass, discriminate, impersonate, publish private information, or spam.

These rules apply to Issues, PRs, and activities representing the project. Maintainers may request changes, remove violations, or restrict repeated offenders.

Report a problem with an Issue that omits sensitive details and requests a private contact channel. Maintainer: [everclear077](https://github.com/everclear077).
